notes.title: Price reduction
notes.content:
Hi all!

Good news, the price of the game is reduced. Forever!
In addition, the first 10 members who have left comments for this news will get the key.

I have a good mood today, and what you all want!

Thank you =)

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Project update

Added saving settings

BugFix
- redesigned some levels
- little changes in menu navigation
- fixed bug press-machines in 8 chapter
- fixed exit full screen mode

Added 2 easter eggs
- the player can accelerate the ripening of apples
- using berries player can unlock all levels of the game

Added sensitivity setting for controller (please, check it)

And other little updates.

notes.content:
Hi all!

Today I added a trading cards. Unfortunately, I could not do it earlier.
